violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Potentially hazardous food Maintained an internal temperature of 54-55

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. A scoop handle was stored in the coleslaw.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean .
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
